name: @test-cabinet/simple-2d
description: The Simple 2D engine: the runtime a produced 2D game is built on. It owns the frame loop and delta time, the letterboxed device-pixel-ratio-aware canvas fit, named input actions over keyboard bindings and touch layouts, a synthesized audio cue bus with its first-interaction unlock, asset resolution under a fixed root, and a diagnostics overlay — leaving the game to write only its own simulation and rendering. It also installs a host interface on `window` so a driver can replace the clock, drive actions, and read the cue, asset, and diagnostic logs.
